title: Supply Unit seal

posts.caption:
Keep the seal on for 5 days, until you are sure of the size.

Every pair leaves with a numbered DAUR SUPPLY UNIT seal on the top eyelet. A size exchange within 5 days of delivery needs the leather shoes unworn, in the box, with the seal attached. The return courier is paid by the buyer. Delivery across Pakistan with Cash on Delivery.

First photo: mood photography of leather (Pexels). Kit shown is a design render.

Save this so the 5 day rule is there when you need it.
